habitat: Humid rainforests in the lowlands of Sri Lanka's Wet Zone
story: The Serendib Scops Owl (Otus thilohoffmanni) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Strigidae family. It is most commonly observed in Humid rainforests in the lowlands of Sri Lanka's Wet Zone, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Endangered (EN) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Serendib Scops Owl is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Serendib Scops Owl into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
